stories.headline: Intel announces Core Ultra 200S Plus desktop CPUs with up to 24 cores for $300

key_facts.fact: Intel unveiled the Core Ultra 7 270K Plus (24 cores, 5.5GHz turbo, $300) and Core Ultra 5 250K Plus (18 cores, 5.3GHz, $200) desktop processors, shipping March 26.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel claims it has finally surpassed both predecessors with 'Intel's fastest gaming desktop processors ever': the Intel Core Ultra 7 270K Plus and 250K Plus, shipping March 26th.

key_facts.fact: The Arrow Lake refresh adds more efficiency cores and up to 900 MHz higher clocks vs predecessors, delivering 100% improvement in multithread performance and 15% faster gaming.
key_facts.excerpt: The Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus series will feature more cores and up to 900 MHz die-to-die frequency increase compared to the Core Ultra 7 265K/KF and Core Ultra 5 245K/KF, powering significant boosts to multithread performance.

key_facts.fact: Intel introduced its Binary Optimization Tool, a first-of-its-kind binary translation layer that can improve native game performance, and added DDR5 7200 MT/s support (up from 6400 MT/s).
key_facts.excerpt: These chips are the first to feature the new Intel Binary Optimization Tool, a first-of-its-kind binary translation layer optimization capability that can improve native performance in select games.

key_facts.fact: Intel's strategy undercuts AMD on cores-per-dollar: 24 cores for $300 vs AMD's 8-core Ryzen 7 9700X at $299, though AMD's 3D V-Cache chips retain a gaming lead.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel has a new strategy for shoring up its eroding market share: Offering PC buyers more cores per dollar than arch-rival AMD... 24 cores for a hair under $300 or 18 cores for just shy of $200.

stories.headline: TSMC posts record February revenue on AI chip demand, nears 70% foundry market share

key_facts.fact: TSMC reported consolidated February sales of NT$317.66 billion (US$9.98 billion), the highest ever for the month, up 22.2% year-over-year, driven by robust 3nm chip demand.
key_facts.excerpt: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co yesterday reported consolidated sales last month reached NT$317.66 billion (US$9.98 billion), the highest ever for the month of February, driven by robust demand for chips built using the company's advanced 3-nanometer process.

key_facts.fact: For the first two months of 2026, TSMC posted cumulative sales of NT$718.91 billion, up 29.9% from a year earlier, with full-year revenue projected to grow about 30% in US dollar terms.
key_facts.excerpt: For the first two months of the year, TSMC posted cumulative sales of NT$718.91 billion, up 29.9 percent from a year earlier.

key_facts.fact: TrendForce data shows TSMC achieved 69.9% global foundry market share in 2025 with revenue of $122.54 billion (up 36.1% YoY), while Samsung fell to 7.2% with a 3.9% revenue decline.
key_facts.excerpt: TSMC, the industry leader, posted revenue of 122.54 billion dollars last year and achieved a market share of 69.9 percent. Runner-up Samsung Electronics recorded annual revenue of 12.63 billion dollars, with a market share of just 7.2 percent.

key_facts.fact: The market share gap between TSMC and Samsung widened from 55 percentage points in 2024 to 62.7 percentage points in 2025, driven by AI GPU and Google TPU demand.
key_facts.excerpt: The annual market share gap with TSMC widened sharply from 55 percentage points in 2024 to 62.7 percentage points last year.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia contributed NT$726.9 billion, about 19% of TSMC's total 2025 sales, making it the chipmaker's largest single customer.
key_facts.excerpt: AI chip giant Nvidia Corp has become a key driver of TSMC's revenue, contributing NT$726.9 billion, or about 19 percent, to TSMC's total sales last year.

stories.headline: Renault to deploy 350 Wandercraft Calvin humanoid robots on factory lines

key_facts.fact: At Renault's 2026 strategy day on March 11, the company announced it will deploy 350 Calvin humanoid robots over the next 18 months, developed by French robotics firm Wandercraft.
key_facts.excerpt: He'll be joined by another 350 fellow humanoids over the next 18 months, as Renault experiments with AI-trained exoskeletons that understand their environment, navigate it autonomously and select different parts.

key_facts.fact: Calvin is already working on the Douai factory supply line hauling tyres for electric cars like the Scenic and Renault 5, at a plant producing 1 car per minute.
key_facts.excerpt: Calvin is a humanoid robot, developed by French robotics firm Wandercraft, that's already doing shifts on the Douai factory supply line. It's hauling tyres for electric cars such as the Scenic and Renault 5.

key_facts.fact: Wandercraft CEO Jean-Louis Constanza called it an industry first: 'This is the day when France and Europe would take up the challenge in humanoids... Now we start deploying robots, the race is on and we have stolen a march on competition.'
key_facts.excerpt: While Renault was explaining their productivity strategy two things happened: On the screen, they showed Calvin, Wandercraft's humanoid, working in conditions of production... Thierry Charvet announced they are deploying 350 units. This is a first.

key_facts.fact: Calvin-40 leverages 12 years of exoskeleton development, can carry 120 kg loads, and uses Vision Language Action (VLA) AI. Wandercraft holds 30+ patents and has 100 medical exoskeletons deployed on four continents.
key_facts.excerpt: One year ago we were revealing our first humanoid, Calvin-40, developed in 40 days but leveraging 12 years of developing the most reliable and powerful exoskeletons then robots.

key_facts.fact: Renault industrial boss Thierry Charvet emphasized cost efficiency over novelty: 'I'm not interested in having a humanoid robot, but having efficient and low cost automation devices.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'I'm not interested in having a humanoid robot, but having efficient and low cost automation devices,' says the supply chain chief.

sources.title: Renault Calvin is an industry-first humanoid robot that's already helping build cars

stories.headline: Amazon's Zoox partners with Uber for robotaxi rides in Las Vegas and Los Angeles

key_facts.fact: Zoox and Uber announced a multi-year strategic partnership to make Zoox's purpose-built, steering-wheel-free robotaxis available on the Uber app, starting in Las Vegas this summer.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon-owned Zoox plans to make its robotaxis available to hail on the Uber app in Las Vegas later this year, the two companies announced Wednesday.

key_facts.fact: The partnership includes plans to expand to Los Angeles by mid-2027. Zoox will continue offering rides on its own app as well.
key_facts.excerpt: Zoox and Uber Technologies have announced a strategic partnership to deploy Zoox's purpose-built robotaxis on Uber's rideshare network.

key_facts.fact: Zoox still needs NHTSA approval to commercially deploy its vehicles; on the same day, NHTSA began taking public comment on Zoox's exemption application for up to 2,500 steering-wheel-free vehicles.
key_facts.excerpt: On Wednesday, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) began taking public comment on Zoox's application for those exemptions.

key_facts.fact: Waymo, the current US robotaxi leader, surpassed 400,000 weekly rides across six metro areas in February and aims to exceed 1 million weekly rides by end of 2026.
key_facts.excerpt: Waymo said in February that it had surpassed 400,000 weekly rides across six U.S. metro areas.

key_facts.fact: Zoox is also mapping and building presence in eight other US cities including Dallas and Phoenix. This is its first third-party platform partnership.
key_facts.excerpt: It's also mapping and building up a presence in eight other U.S. cities, including Dallas and Phoenix. This is Zoox's first third-party partnership with a platform like Uber.

stories.headline: Creekstone Energy secures 13,000-acre lease for 1 GW solar powering 10 GW data center campus in Utah

key_facts.fact: Creekstone Energy signed the largest solar lease by acreage in Utah history — 13,000 acres in Millard County — to power the Delta Gigasite, a 10 GW data center campus on 1,100 acres.
key_facts.excerpt: The contract represents the largest solar lease by acreage in the history of the state. The site is planned for 10 GW of capacity to support artificial intelligence and computing tasks.

key_facts.fact: The first phase develops 1 GW of solar capacity, which will increase Utah's total solar footprint by approximately 21%. Site preparation begins immediately, with electricity production scheduled for 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: Millard County officials issued zoning approval for the first phase of the project, which involves the development of 1 GW of solar capacity... electricity production scheduled for 2027.

key_facts.fact: The power infrastructure combines 1 GW solar, 280 MW solar plus long-duration storage with Zeo Energy, 300 MW gas capacity, and Torus battery and flywheel systems for load smoothing.
key_facts.excerpt: Creekstone Energy partnered with Zeo Energy to develop 280 MW of solar and long-duration storage capacity at the site. The infrastructure also features 300 MW of gas-powered capacity and utilizes Torus battery and flywheel systems for load smoothing.

key_facts.fact: Revenue from the state trust land lease goes to Utah's public education system. Millard County has issued zoning approval for the first phase.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue from the land lease goes to Utah's public education system.

sources.title: Creekstone Energy secures 13,000-acre lease for 1 GW solar project in Utah

stories.headline: SYOS SA200 autonomous heavy-lift helicopter clears endurance trials, enters serial production

key_facts.fact: UK-based SYOS Aerospace announced on March 11 that its SA200 uncrewed autonomous helicopter completed fully autonomous endurance trials, including take-off and landing from a moving platform, clearing it for serial production.
key_facts.excerpt: UK-based SYOS Aerospace said on March 11, 2026, that its SA200 heavy-lift uncrewed helicopter has completed endurance trials and fully autonomous mission testing, clearing the aircraft for serial production.

key_facts.fact: The SA200 can carry up to 200 kg over 180 km and is designed for cargo transport, ISR, and electronic warfare missions in contested environments.
key_facts.excerpt: The SA200 UAV can carry up to 200 kilograms over 180 kilometers and is designed for cargo transport, ISR, and electronic warfare missions.

key_facts.fact: The helicopter is powered by the AAIMS autonomy stack and represents the culmination of a five-year development programme, offering what SYOS calls the best cost-to-capability ratio in market.
key_facts.excerpt: SYOS SA200 UAV powered by AAIMS autonomy stack and the culmination of five years of development, offers best cost-to-capability ratio in market.

key_facts.fact: Moving-platform autonomous landing is a key milestone for maritime and expeditionary operations, replicating ship-borne and vehicle-based use cases.
key_facts.excerpt: The trials have reportedly proved the heavy-lift aircraft's ability to execute fully autonomous operations, including take-off and landing, from a moving platform, replicating ship-borne and vehicle-based operations.

stories.headline: Firefly Aerospace's Alpha rocket reaches orbit on Flight 7 with Lockheed Martin payload

key_facts.fact: Firefly Aerospace's Alpha rocket successfully launched on its 'Stairway to Seven' mission from Vandenberg Space Force Base at 5:50 PM PDT on March 11, completing orbital insertion and delivering a demonstrator payload for Lockheed Martin.
key_facts.excerpt: Firefly Aerospace today announced the successful launch of its Alpha Flight 7 Stairway to Seven mission. Alpha lifted off from Space Launch Complex 2 at the Vandenberg Space Force Base at 5:50 pm PDT on March 11.

key_facts.fact: The flight tested and validated key Alpha Block II upgrades including a new in-house avionics suite and enhanced thermal protection system.
key_facts.excerpt: Firefly's Alpha rocket also performed a stage two engine relight and validated key Alpha Block II upgrades, including a new in-house avionics suite and enhanced thermal protection system.

key_facts.fact: This was Alpha's first launch in 10 months, following explosive accidents last year. CEO Jason Kim said: 'Alpha Flight 7 was flawlessly executed with all mission requirements completed.'
key_facts.excerpt: Firefly Aerospace's Alpha rocket reaches orbit on 1st launch since explosive accidents last year.

key_facts.fact: Flight 8 will feature the full Block II configuration with a 7-foot length increase, consolidated in-house batteries and avionics, and stronger carbon composite structures.
key_facts.excerpt: The upgrades include a 7-foot increase to Alpha's length, consolidated batteries and avionics built in house, improved thermal protection.

sources.title: Firefly Aerospace Successfully Launches Alpha Flight 7

stories.headline: Northrop Grumman's first Cygnus XL cargo spacecraft departs ISS after delivering 11,000 lbs

key_facts.fact: Northrop Grumman's Cygnus XL spacecraft, the first flight of the larger cargo variant, departed the International Space Station on March 12 at 7:06 AM EDT while orbiting 262 miles above the Atlantic.
key_facts.excerpt: Northrop Grumman's 1st 'Cygnus XL' cargo spacecraft departs the space station.

key_facts.fact: The Cygnus XL delivered more than 11,000 pounds (5,000 kg) of science experiments, supplies, and research materials to the ISS Expedition 73 crew.
key_facts.excerpt: Cygnus XL is Northrop Grumman's expanded version of its previous Cygnus cargo craft increasing its payload capacity and pressurized cargo volume.

key_facts.fact: The spacecraft was released from the Unity module using the Canadarm2 robotic arm, with ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot monitoring systems. It will deorbit on March 14 to burn up over the Pacific with thousands of pounds of station trash.
key_facts.excerpt: Flight controllers on the ground will send commands for the Canadarm2 robotic arm to detach the Cygnus XL from the Unity module's Earth-facing port. Cygnus XL will be commanded to deorbit on Saturday, March 14.

key_facts.fact: Named the S.S. William 'Willie' McCool, the spacecraft launched in September 2025 on a SpaceX Falcon 9. This was the second ground-controlled robotic release from the station following JAXA's HTVX1 departure the previous week.
key_facts.excerpt: The Northrop Grumman spacecraft launched in September 2025 on a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket. Today's departure marks the second ground controlled robotic release of a cargo ship to leave station following the departure of JAXA's HTVX1 last week.
